source_quantities.storage: Optional owned SpellView.source_quantity_lki box with only selected signed toughness and/or equipment count; no hot Object fields or persistent history rows
source_quantities.live: Exact current battlefield incarnation and current derived characteristics; source control changes do not redirect the captured trigger controller
source_quantities.departure: Selected values freeze before the first commit of the entire simultaneous movement batch, at every actual commit caller: ordinary single transition, raw batch, staged entries, irreversible cast rollback replay
source_quantities.guards: Whiplash checks positive effective Equipment count when the declared-attack event occurs and again on resolution using exact live or departure facts
source_quantities.quantity: Effective Equipment subtype counts regardless of controller; Auras without Equipment do not count; later equipment movement/type changes and new source incarnations do not alter departed source facts
source_quantities.growth: Wings freezes one nonnegative source toughness and the set of every other controlled Hero permanent at resolution, including Kindred noncreatures. Exclusion compares ObjectRef, so a returned new source is other
source_quantities.life: Opponent loss then controller gain use the same original X once. Existing DrainLifeScaled actual-loss semantics remain unchanged
source_quantities.privacy_and_ownership: Payload contains public battlefield facts only; owned packet cloning, snapshots/restores and byte accounting include its allocation

rules_evidence.facts: Each X is calculated once at resolution, using latest battlefield source facts after departure

source_discrepancies: Wings direct Java uses a creature-only Hero filter; the Oracle effect includes each other Hero permanent

Whiplash direct Java equipped condition queries a live source only and its quantity helper re-queries later surviving attachments; official rulings require the source's last battlefield equipment count
Ordinary negative calculated X for Wings growth is treated as zero under CR107.1b; a noncreature source has no toughness
validation_limits: Focused and full native tests are deterministic rules regression evidence. Full aggregate release validation, two independent nonauthor published-head reviews, complete all-281-card MSH-only game acceptance and final user approval remain required. No new parent PR or main merge is authorized.

trace_proof.previous_wire_method: The unchanged recorder recomputes every complete Trace with prior wire version143. No Trace fields or observation content are stripped, and all six inherited Trace fields compare exactly.
